facts.text: John found a new gym with a basketball court and cones to help maintain his basketball skills.

evidence.quote: I found a new gym to stay on my b-ball game. Staying fit is essential to surviving pro ball, so I had to find something that fits the bill.
Here's a photo of a gym with a basketball court and cones.

facts.text: John had to adapt and tweak his routine to find the right balance between basketball training and strength training.

evidence.quote: I had to overcome the hurdle of adapting and tweaking my routine. Finding the right balance was tricky, but I eventually got the hang of it.
I figured out a schedule with both basketball stuff and strength training to balance it out.

facts.text: John's workout plan includes listening to his body and giving it enough rest to help him stay on track.

evidence.quote: Listening to my body and giving it enough rest made it easier to push myself during practice but also look after me.
